articles.summary: Heritage Global Partners (“HGP”), a subsidiary of Heritage Global Inc. (NASDAQ: HGBL) and a worldwide leader in asset advisory and auction services, in conjunction with Prestige Auctions, today announced it will conduct an online auction of assets from National Oilwell Varco’s (NOV) Dayton facility – formerly known as Dayton Chemineer. The auction will take place Thursday, March 12, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET, with assets located in Dayton, Ohio.
articles.title: HGP & Prestige to Conduct Complete Plant Closure Auction of NOV
